signal_words: supervisory notice; circular; bulletin; guidance note; Q&A; press statement; reminder of obligations under another act
question_to_ask: are the instrument's own numbered application and definition provisions reproduced in the inputs
verdict_if_no: Ambiguous (no operative text; scope cannot be read from a notice) at Low
typical_mistake: reading the notice's recipient list or due date as if it set scope

signal_words: applies to; has its seat in; incorporated in; carries on business in
question_to_ask: do the profile's stated seat or place of business answer the clause
verdict_if_no: Fails (home route closed; other reach routes tested)
typical_mistake: giving up after the home route fails although a foreign route is printed

signal_words: supplies to; markets to; takes bookings from; handles payments to or from
question_to_ask: does the organisation direct activity at the territory
label_effect: out only once every route has failed
typical_mistake: treating a site anyone can open as aimed at the territory

signal_words: only where; limited to holders of; in the activities listed in
question_to_ask: does the profile state the activity sector licence or register class named
verdict_if_no: Fails (trigger not met; instrument does not reach the organisation)
typical_mistake: omitting the trigger row because some other clause failed first

question_to_ask: with the definition substituted for the term does the organisation still fit
verdict_if_no: Fails (definition not met; organisation is not the defined subject)
typical_mistake: testing the everyday word rather than the definition

signal_words: without meaningful human review; free of charge; without the person's participation; solely between companies
question_to_ask: is the thing the definition needs to be absent actually there
verdict_if_yes: Passes (element met; nothing of the kind is present)
verdict_if_no: Fails (element not met; the thing is present on the stated facts)
label_effect: the definition fails when the thing is there
typical_mistake: passing it because a system produces the output while a person makes the call

question_to_ask: does the profile satisfy the exclusion's own wording
verdict_if_yes: Passes (exclusion applies; organisation is not the defined subject) or Passes (exclusion applies; confirms [deciding clause])
verdict_if_no: Fails (exclusion does not apply; definition still met)
typical_mistake: merging the exclusion into the definition row as a double negative

signal_words: in particular; for example; including without limitation
question_to_ask: nothing to ask once the main test has decided
typical_mistake: letting an example meet the test by itself

signal_words: is not a covered person for the purposes of; is treated as outside; this Act does not apply to
question_to_ask: does every condition hold (one row listing each condition with its result)
verdict_if_yes: Passes (carve-out satisfied; organisation removed from the instrument)
verdict_if_no: Fails (removal does not apply; organisation remains covered)
typical_mistake: checking one condition and ignoring the rest

signal_words: not counted for; excluded from the calculation in; disregarded when counting
question_to_ask: which units does it take out of another clause's count
verdict_if_no: Passes (nothing to deduct on the stated facts)
label_effect: changes only the count it feeds; its row sits directly above that count's row
typical_mistake: placing the deduction row after the threshold it reduces

signal_words: Part III applies only to; Chapter 4 applies where; Articles 8 to 12 apply above
question_to_ask: after any deductions and on the clause's own basis is the line crossed
verdict_if_no: Fails (Part does not apply; rest applies)
typical_mistake: working out figures after the organisation is already out

signal_words: is exempt from; is not required to comply with; provided that
question_to_ask: does the entity's own figure meet the exemption and any cap written into it (a share shown as a division on the clause's own base; where another clause deducted from a count also give the share on the deducted base and say whether the answer changes)
verdict_if_yes: Passes (exemption satisfied on entity figure; limit row follows)
verdict_if_no: Fails (exemption not available; named sections apply)
label_effect: takes away only the sections it lists
typical_mistake: listing sections the exemption does not mention

signal_words: notwithstanding; does not apply if; unless; may be withdrawn
question_to_ask: is the group cap control test or share ceiling set off (a share shown as a division; on both bases where a deduction elsewhere makes the base arguable)
verdict_if_yes: Passes (limit triggered; exemption voided; named sections apply)
label_effect: cancels the exemption and nothing else
typical_mistake: overlooking the basis on which the profile states a share

label_effect: send the substitute duty to routing
typical_mistake: treating it as a precondition of coverage

signal_words: as specified by; to be fixed by regulation; as the minister may designate
question_to_ask: does a listing licence or class in the profile settle today's status
verdict_if_yes: Passes (listing settles current status; pending act concerns future classification)
verdict_if_no: Ambiguous (criteria unpublished; label already fixed by the deciding clause)
typical_mistake: leaving the row out because the regulation has not been made

signal_words: must register; must report; within 14 days; inspection
verdict_if_yes: Passes (duty applies; compliance gap not scope)
typical_mistake: lowering the label over an unfiled registration

signal_words: comes into force on; with effect from [date]
typical_mistake: making the label CONDITIONAL because the start date is in the future
